what: A WebGL2 fluid is laid behind the pasted panel, and over the panel it sprays a radius .005 mark by the amount the mouse moved (×6000). Velocity field 128 cells·dye 512 cells, vorticity 10, 20 pressure iterations, velocity fades at 2 per second and dye at 3.5 per second, so it settles in a little over 1 second. The gradient of dye brightness raises a grain (light .7 to 1) so the panel’s text-color light spreads like a rippled thin film, and brightness wobbles ±7% every .1s. On first open, six random marks are already spread out. A press leaves one small mark at that spot

options.radius: Mark radius (uv² units, widened by the aspect ratio if wide), default .005
options.force: Mouse movement (uv) → flow force multiplier, default 6000
options.strength: Light brightness (text color luminance multiplier), default .5
options.seeds: Initial number of marks laid down, default 6

note: Same family as fluid-glow-cursor, but that one is the three version with per-frame decay and light bleed, while this one uses a single WebGL2 with no three and produces swirl, per-second decay and grain shading (light slope) at the original values. Drawing pauses when the panel is off screen. Not attached on touch devices or with reduced motion (it never blocks phone scrolling).
